name: Sea Center Volunteers (Ty Warner Sea Center)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History, Ty Warner Sea Center
what_you_do: Help guests at the Stearns Wharf aquarium meet live animals, from sea anemones to small sharks, with hands-on demonstrations and live animal talks. Teens 14 and up can train as aquarist volunteers.
who_can_apply: Anyone age 11 and up. Volunteers 11 to 13 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. Aquarist volunteers must be 14 or older and have done 48 hours of service first. Commit to one shift a week for at least four months.
pay_detail: Unpaid. A $45 program fee covers uniform, badge and administration; email scvolunteer@sbnature2.org for a fee waiver before your first training.
duration: One shift per week for at least 4 months
deadline_text: The Museum's teen page says the Sea Center accepts volunteer applications year-round.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online volunteer application, interview, then attend mandatory training. Contact scvolunteer@sbnature2.org or 805-962-2526 ext. 110.
notes: Counts for the community service hours needed to graduate from high school in Santa Barbara Unified (per the Museum). Shifts are 9:45-12:45, 12:30-3:30 or 3:00-5:00.
